name: 54840 · Grantsburg, WI
findings: ZIP 54840 (Grantsburg) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54840 (Grantsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54840 (Grantsburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
